capabilities: Import ZIP chat exports from supported providers as Markdown notes
Preview and filter conversations before importing all or a selection
Update existing notes incrementally and deduplicate across export archives
Extract attachments such as images and documents from exports
Write structured notes with role callouts, ISO 8601 frontmatter, and import reports
extras: Full documentation lives in a separate docs/ directory rather than the README; UI is localized in 10 languages; a separate command-line importer exists in its own repository; requires Obsidian 1.6.6+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn AI provider export archives into organized, editable Markdown notes with metadata and attachments.

relations.evidence: the official export and the Thread Exporter extension work together

requires.name: Export archives from ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral Vibe, Perplexity, or Grok

summary: Plugin that imports AI chat exports from ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral Vibe, Perplexity, and Grok into Obsidian as structured Markdown notes.
